finding.observed: Current main bounded auth/control/PTy messages only after Uvicorn had delivered a complete ASGI WebSocket message. clayverse.service invoked uvicorn.run without an explicit WebSocket message-size or queue bound.
finding.counterhypothesis: The application-level 64 KiB check is sufficient because the ASGI server already enforces an equally small transport bound.
finding.counterhypothesis_result: REJECTED_BY_CONFIGURATION_SOURCE: service.py supplied no ws_max_size, while the pinned Uvicorn line exposes a much larger default unless configured.
finding.product_contract: Inbound terminal traffic must be bounded and fail closed without depending on a larger framework default before application validation.

external_primary_evidence.uvicorn_release_context: Uvicorn release notes show ws_max_size support extended to wsproto in 0.46; this repair explicitly selects websockets so the documented queue/deflate controls are not protocol-ambiguous.
